page.overview:
Who is Cyrus Hume?

was a warden of the stockade in Emon. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Cyrus Hume was a gentleman with a well-kept mustache, thick over the top lip and slicked black hair that curled up in the back in a small poof. He was wearing a breastplate and was standing with an appearance of self-importance.

Cyrus Hume was first seen speaking to Dr. Dranzel inside the stockade of Emon. Percival de Rolo and Scanlan Shorthalt, after a short negotiation with the warden and hearng of the fines caused by Kaylie, Scanlan's daughter, attempted and failed at bribing to release her. He had Scanlan arrested.
